title: LiveLoRA: Exact KV Cache Migration Across LoRA Updates for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.31105v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Updating an LLM adapter should not require replaying the full interaction history of every active session. Yet reusing key-value (KV) cache entries computed under an earlier version mixes model versions, while full-history re-prefill becomes increasingly costly as histories and session fleets grow. We introduce LiveLora, a model-runtime co-design for exact final-block KV cache migration. Frozen lower decoder blocks and fixed K/V adapter down-projections preserve each token's base projections and low-rank coordinates across adapter versions. The runtime reconstructs candidate K/V, reevaluates the latest token through the final block, and commits the adapter, cache, and next-token logits together. We prove continuation equivalence to full-history re-prefill in exact arithmetic under the stated model assumptions. translated_title: LiveLoRA：面向大语言模型智能体的LoRA更新中精确KV缓存迁移
translated_abstract: 更新大语言模型适配器不应需要重放每个活跃会话的完整交互历史。然而，复用在早期模型版本下计算的键值（KV）缓存条目会混合不同模型版本，而随着历史长度和会话规模的不断增长，完整历史重新预填充的成本也日益高昂。我们提出LiveLoRA，一种用于精确末端块KV缓存迁移的模型-运行时协同设计方法。冻结的较低解码器层和固定的K/V适配器下投影，在各适配器版本之间保留了每个token的基础投影和低秩坐标。运行时重建候选K/V，通过最终解码块重新评估最新token，并原子性地提交适配器、缓存和下一个token的logits。我们在既定模型假设下，证明了该方法在精确算术下与完整历史重新预填充具有延续等价性。在Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct上，五次运行中相对完整历史重新预填充的成对发布加速中位数平均达到68.98倍。
tldr: LiveLoRA通过冻结底层解码器块并固定K/V适配器下投影，实现了LoRA适配器更新时KV缓存的精确迁移，在数学上与完整历史重新预填充严格等价，同时平均获得68.98倍加速。
en_tdlr: LiveLoRA achieves exact KV cache migration across LoRA adapter updates by freezing lower decoder blocks and fixing K/V down-projections, producing outputs mathematically equivalent to full-history re-prefill with an average 68.98× speedup.
